name: 西游记2006之最终幻想
english_name: Journey to the West 2006: Final Fantasy (AKAI Studio / Tomud)
english_description: A Journey to the West mythology MUD from AKAI Studio's Tomud-branded lineage, byte-identical in file layout and bug set to this collection's sibling xyj2006n (down to sharing the same client-detection gate: the first line sent after connecting must be the bare literal "2060", the automatic reply from Tomud/"Smiling Proud Wanderer" clients, or the connection is dropped as illegal). New characters start at a South City Inn and can apprentice into the Lingtai Fangcun Mountain / Three-Star Cave sect under second-generation disciple Guang Yunzi; a gift-giving NPC there hands new arrivals a free starter set of thirteen basic skills. This archive is where a previously-undocumented bug class was first pinned down and logged as AGENTS.md §7.154: background call_outs unrelated to any player command (a corpse decaying to ash outdoors, the driver's own day/night cycle destroying an outdoor NPC) invoked the same look-room logic as the "look" command and crashed on a null player reference several times an hour purely from world upkeep -- invisible to ordinary playtesting, only caught via debug.log. Also fixed: a missing-directory crash in the shared log_file() routine (which would have silently broken the welcome banner's own advertised "suicide -f" account-deletion command) and an identical gap in the leaderboard-save daemon that had been silently wiping all eleven rankings on every login.
